messages:
mira (docs): quick heads up — product asked for a short deprecation banner + full migration guide for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. need owner for docs PR + snippets.
owen (eng): I can draft the migration guide. please confirm breaking changes from SDK.
lina (sdk): main breaks: header rename (Authorization -> x-rw-api-key), endpoint change (/v1/generate -> /v2/responses), payload prompt -> input, and streaming framing update. will provide short curl and TS diffs.
mira (docs): include curl + TS examples, 1-line banner under 90 chars, and an FAQ entry for header grep. also draft email subject lines.
vince (product): retirement target: alias redwood/text-legacy retired 2026-06-25 23:59UTC. we'll run a 30-day public notice starting 2026-05-26. docs must list alias pinning and contact support for exceptions.
owen (eng): infra ok with 30 days. i'll add oncall verification tasks and a troubleshooting table describing 401/404/502 cases.
lina (sdk): minimal snippets for docs:
# v1 curl
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# v2 curl
curl -X POST -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
mira (docs): great — i'll keep a short quickstart for the banner and place full snippets in the migration appendix. action items: 1) owen opens docs PR with migration guide + banner copy, 2) lina updates SDK README with a migration note linking to docs, 3) vince confirms announcement timing and legal copy. target merge: 2026-05-24. please drop PR links here when ready and react with :thumbsup: when reviewed. thanks!
